decision.reason: Both cooperative-yield candidates redistribute latency and regress a shared-reader case. Preserve the original execution path.

limitations: Unoptimized local macOS ARM64; synthetic backend timer, not production S3/device service time.
Decode overlap is wall time inside decoder calls, not sampled CPU residency.
Predecoded ablation preserves reads and value checks but intentionally skips scan decode/checksum work; it is diagnostic only.
Do not compare absolute latency across separate cohorts; compare paired variants within each cohort.
Percentile differences are not additive stage attribution.
